info.name: Takealot Seller Create a batch view sales API
Retrieve Information About Your Sales On The Takealot Platform

params.name: version
params.description: The major version of the API, prepended with a v (e.g. v1)

params.name: filters
params.description: A list of search parameters (supported fields are start_date, end_date, sku, product_title, tsin, dc, customer_dc, sale_status, po_number, order_id, promotion) e.g. ?filters=sku:foo;title:bar

params.name: page_number
params.description: The page number to retrieve (starting at 1)

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of sales per page. Limited to 100.

items.docs: Get sales based on filters passed through
